title: The AC Method
text:
When factorising $ax^2 + bx + c$ with $a \neq 1$:

1. Multiply $a \times c$
2. Find two numbers that multiply to $ac$ and add to $b$
3. Use these to split the middle term

Here: $a = 2$, $b = 7$, $c = 3$
So $ac = 2 \times 3 = 6$

title: Find the Factor Pair
text:
Factor pairs of 6:
- $1 \times 6 = 6$ (sum = $7$) ✓
- $2 \times 3 = 6$ (sum = $5$)

The pair $1$ and $6$ works: $1 \times 6 = 6$ and $1 + 6 = 7$

title: The Two Numbers
text:
The numbers are $6$ and $1$.

These will be used to split the middle term $7x$ into $6x + 1x$.
